introCutscene.text: Mrs. Kowalski received a panicked voicemail from her grandson — or so she thought.
The voice said he was in jail and needed $5,000 bail. But her grandson was sitting next to her.
Analyze the audio for synthetic markers. Trace the call metadata. Find the truth.

conclusionText: The voice was AI-cloned using just 3 seconds of audio from the grandson's social media. The call originated from a VoIP number registered overseas. AI voice cloning is becoming dangerously accessible.
